title: Shrubbery!
intro: The bushes are in different places on every map. Look before you leap: [b]if/else[/b] checks a sensor and runs exactly one of its two branches.
cs_note: A [b]conditional[/b] picks one branch. Cutting on every step would also clear the way, but it costs 4 stamina per tile; checking first is free. Conditions buy efficiency.
hints: Keep going until you're at the exit: while not at_exit().
Inside the loop: if a bush is ahead, cut it, otherwise move.

Use the [b]if … else[/b] block, which has two mouths. Each pass of the loop does exactly one thing: cut the bush in front, or step forward. The while keeps going however many bushes a map has. To make "not at_exit()", click the [b]not[/b] toggle on the while block.
